scope: Derived simulator acquisitions, fixed exploration and subsequent reserved-subject checking; no patient images.

decision.scope: Modest engineering improvement of the normal convex preset under the recorded acquisition protocol.
decision.rationale: Required CI gates passed. At primary DR70 all four prespecified metrics move toward both descriptive reference groups in all three windows without new censoring; wall and haze brighten with less black clipping and unchanged zero white clipping of the pleural peak.
decision.does_not_establish: Clinical validity, equivalence to real ultrasound, complete calibration, or generalization across patients, devices and probe types.
decision.residuals: All four primary metric values remain outside both groups subject-level p10–p90 descriptions. T1 lateral worsens slightly at BLUE superior and PLAPS against checking.

protocol.selection_rule: Preserve required gates and interpretable exploration improvement before opening checking. Reference quantiles are descriptive, not clinical thresholds.
protocol.checking_opening: Authorized only after completed green CI81 and fixation of K54/Rt0.30/gain−20; same stored candidate and baseline rows then compared without tuning.
protocol.metrics_estimator: Median across the three captured replicate frames; IQR and censor status retained.
protocol.levels_estimator: levelsDb contains regional grey/peak statistics from the first analyzed frame, not replicate medians. displayDb is derived from that grey; envelopeDb is the display-referred level including gain/TGC from the first-frame envelope.

provenance.capture_metadata_source: Commits and CI runs confirmed by coordinator; captured outputs retain source hashes.

limitations: Aggregate bank statistics had been read before the subject split; this is not blind, clinical, or external validation.

Each group has only two contributing subjects for M.wall, M.haze and A2.r2. T1.sigmaOverProminence uses four exploration and two checking subjects. Quantile precision does not imply narrow biological variability.
Reference devices, frequencies and physical scales are undocumented per clip; human reference-bank QA remains pending.
The only usable convex rib shadows belong to an exploration subject; checking does not validate rib-shadow appearance.
Censored values are retained as bounds or unknown quantities and are not ranked by point estimates.
DR50/60 include substantial clipping. DR70 is primary; the remaining display ranges are diagnostic.
Three replicate frames at one apnea time do not measure temporal fidelity, sliding behavior or respiratory dynamics.
Metrics depend on detected structures and region selection. Baseline capture did not include detectorSupport/coherence logs, so equal anatomical ROIs cannot be demonstrated from these reduced rows.
The rejected candidates changed K, Rt and gain together. The accepted candidate changes K and gain while retaining Rt; measured changes are joint effects, not isolated causal estimates.
The baseline capture uses the same physical parameter values as e28aaa0; this record includes its later instrumentation commit.
Peak order k=1 denotes pleura; k=4 is the fourth harmonic depth position, not an assertion that four A-lines are visibly present at the default display.
Checking has now been consulted. Any later tuning based on these checking results must be declared further exploration, not an untouched holdout.
